name: MMLongBench-Doc
intro: MMLongBench-Doc 是一个长上下文多模态文档理解基准，基于长篇 PDF 文档、专家标注问题、多源证据、跨页问题和不可回答问题来评估 LVLM。
org: Nanyang Technological University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Fudan University, Sun Yat-sen University
modality: 文档, 文本, 图像, 图表, 表格
eval_feature: 长上下文, 跨页推理, 幻觉检测
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Cross-page Reasoning, Hallucination Detection
intro_en: MMLongBench-Doc is a long-context multimodal document-understanding benchmark built from lengthy PDF documents, expert-annotated questions, multimodal evidence, cross-page questions, and unanswerable cases for LVLM evaluation.

flowchart LR

    F --> G["LVLM/OCR Eval"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.01523 and the MMLongBench-Doc project. The paper constructs the benchmark from 130 long PDF documents, annotates 1,062 expert questions with multimodal/page evidence, includes cross-page and unanswerable questions, compares LVLMs with OCR-fed LLM baselines, and reports F1.
